_description: cashBucketPolicy with refillTrigger='none' — verifies manual mode (engine performs no auto-refill or auto-sweep, but spending still pulls cash first).
_rationale: Cash $100k + Taxable $100k. Policy set with min $20k, target $60k, max $120k BUT refillTrigger='none'. Spending $40k, 0% returns, 0% yield. Year 0: cash drains to 60k (40k spending pull). No refill from surplus (none trigger). No sweep (cash 60k well under max 120k). Demonstrates that 'none' = manual mode: policy fields present, engine does not act on them automatically (other than cash priority in waterfall, which is unconditional).
name: Bucket Manual Mode (none)
